newsitem.title: FRANCE: French share index breaks through 3,000 at open.
newsitem.headline: French share index breaks through 3,000 at open.

text.p: French shares surged through the 3,000 point barrier for the first time ever on Thursday morning, after having tried but failed to break this psychologically important level on Wednesday.

Dealers said that further gains on Wall Street and record levels in London and Frankfurt combined with a strong dollar were behind the rise. Another factor is a large inflow of liquidity into the market, with over 90 billion francs paid by the government on Wednesday to reimburse Balladur bonds.
At 0807 GMT, the CAC-40 index was up 12.90 points or 0.43 percent at 3,000.91. The fresh all-time high stands at 3,006.54.
